findings.summary: FleetStateConfig.repo_path and CLI --repo-path both default to None, while DEFAULT_REPO_PATH (/data/code/self/fleet-graph) is defined but not wired as the default, so an unconfigured `state serve` degrades every terminal=='complete' development to 'unharvested' (false positives). The production systemd unit deploy/systemd/fleet-graph-state.service does wire --repo-path /data/code/self/fleet-graph --default-branch main, so the deployed semantic is correct and the E5 reversal (refused/fault/non-complete excluded) is unaffected. Non-blocking.
